usage: deskops promote inbox-to-drawer-task [-h] [--root ROOT] [--title TITLE]
                                            selector

Promote one inbox note into a deferred drawer task candidate. Warning: this
deletes the source note, and it is not the path for notes that are work. A
note that is work becomes a task with `deskops add task`, with references to
the note, and then `deskops message ack <note>`.

positional arguments:
  selector       Inbox filename, stem, or unique slug fragment

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    Target repository root
  --title TITLE  Override the drawer task title
